offering_description.value: Designs, installs, and maintains HVAC, plumbing, electrical and building control systems for commercial, industrial and institutional buildings. Works mainly on contract for building owners, developers and general contractors across the United States.

primary_products.value: HVAC systems; plumbing systems; electrical systems; building controls

primary_services.value: mechanical installation; maintenance and repair; system retrofits and replacement; prefabrication; facility service

customer_segment.value: B2B: building owners, developers, general contractors, industrial facilities; B2G: public agencies and schools for construction projects

end_markets.value: commercial construction; industrial; healthcare; data centers; education

revenue_model.value: project or contract: installation contracts for new construction and building retrofits; service fees: maintenance, repair and service agreements for installed systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: installs and services building systems, sold to owners and general contractors

geography_served.value: US national: offices in many US states, concentrated in major metropolitan areas

specialization.value: related lines: HVAC, plumbing, electrical and controls contracting for the same building projects

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts directly with building owners and general contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, building codes, workplace safety and refrigerant rules from state boards, OSHA and EPA
